summary: Lafayette Square USA, Inc., a Delaware business development company formerly known as Lafayette Square Empire BDC, filed a Form 8-K on September 30, 2026 reporting entry into a Note Purchase Agreement dated September 29, 2026. The Company privately placed $2.0 million of 7.82% Series A Senior Notes maturing September 29, 2029 and $78.0 million of 8.25% Series B Senior Notes maturing September 29, 2031 with qualified institutional investors under Section 4(a)(2). Interest is payable semiannually, with step-ups up to 2.00% on rating or secured-debt-ratio triggers. Notes are senior unsecured obligations guaranteed by LS BDC Holdings, LLC, with customary BDC, net worth, and asset coverage covenants. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
